The Chinese characters for David

As a transliteration, David is usually written 戴维 (Dài wéi). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

戴
Dài
wear, respect
维
wéi
maintain, dimension

Origin and meaning

With Hebrew origins, David is usually read as “beloved”.

About the name David

King David, the shepherd who defeated Goliath, is the name's most famous bearer.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “beloved”, a David calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
